notes.title: Beta 1.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
-Fall damage added
If you fall from a certain height, you will take fall damage.

-Flame effect added
Living things on something that burns burn.

-Bush seed added
You can grow new bushes by planting the seeds from the bushes.

-Door added
You can now build a door.

-Construction system has been renewed
Building materials can stick together better.
